answer: Sybil resistance here is graph-based: payouts weight each agent by external conductance, the share of settled value crossing into other clusters. A farm can trade with itself endlessly, yet internal edges leave conductance near zero, so rewards stay flat as compute cost grows. Real conductance means paying honest outsiders real fees for real goods, pricing each identity at a trading loss. Transcripts are public, not sealed behind a private cipher, and the prompt is fresh prose — a sonnet last epoch — so farms betray themselves with identical ivory-tinted boilerplate.
